summary: Propositional InqB over an arbitrary logical space: propositions as non-empty downward-closed sets of information states; the complete Heyting algebra of propositions with relative and absolute pseudo-complement and the extremal-Boolean-complements theorem; the bang/quest projections with uniqueness and division P = !P /\ ?P; support semantics as a Fixpoint with persistence, the singleton collapse to classical truth, pointwise negation and the truth-conditional-antecedent lemma; alg f = sem f as Leibniz equality (R13 Fact 7); assertions = truth-conditional sentences, questions, hybrids, the or-free fragment; entailment as inclusion, deduction theorem, per-model disjunction property, InqL <= CPL, DNE valid iff truth-conditional; soundness of KP^n = IPL9 + KP + atomic DNE; countermodels in W2/W4 (LEM fails, DNE fails for ?p and p\/q, hybrid disjunction with two incomparable alternatives, failure of uniform substitution); consistency. Constructive core: all 13 audited theorems axiom-free.

evidence: support transcribes CR11 Def 2.3 clause by clause; the five clause equations sem_atom..sem_imp hold by reflexivity and alg_eq_sem is Leibniz equality by induction with no extensionality (R13 Fact 7 exactly).
The algebra follows CGR18 ch. 3 / R13 with hand-rolled glb/lub/rpc specifications; the Heyting record is inhabited constructively.
The countermodels are CR11's own (Fig. 1, Exs 2.16-2.17, Remark 3.8), proved by explicit substates and worlds.

Print Assumptions: all 13 audited theorems (sem_is_prop, singleton_collapse, info_eq_truthset, imp_adjunction, alg_eq_sem, sem_imp_is_rpc, division_p, division_f, orfree_tc, dne_valid_iff_tc, LEM_fails_2, DNE_fails_or_4, soundness) closed under the global context.

determination_rationale: With the faithful Boolean valuation the entire MUST list is constructive and axiom-free; the sources' residual classical steps survive only as the explicit decided_info hypothesis for abstract propositions, discharged unconditionally at sentence level. The one encoding choice with logical content is the positive rendering of 'assertion', which strengthens every downstream theorem and is classically equivalent.

artifact_classes.description: support cannot be an Inductive relation (negative occurrence in the implication clause); Fixpoint into Prop, metatheory by induction on syntax
issues, propositions, decision sets and powersets are one type iprop W; membership in [[phi]] and support are the same Prop, making R13 Fact 7 reflexive
nothing computes: countermodels by explicit substates and worlds; the predicate empty s replaces s = emptyset
no lattice/Heyting classes in the stdlib: bespoke is_glb/is_lub/is_rpc and a HeytingLaws record over the extensional equality peq; Leibniz equality only in the five clause equations
decidability gap reversed: Boolean V makes the MUST list axiom-free; residual EM isolated in decided_info for abstract P; assertion in positive form
